messages:
carla: FYI — Omnitek wants a 12mo Dedicated commit (mixed GPU pool: A100 + H100) + a burst add-on. They want burst up to 2x baseline for short spikes during POC. Asking for a 25% discount on the burst unit-rate for the POC.
mike: @carla can you paste the proposed numbers? need to run this past deal desk and revops.
carla: Proposed structure:
- Commit: 12mo, baseline 80 A100-equivalent slots
- Burst: up to 160 slots, expected <=10% of time
- Billing: monthly true-up for burst usage
- Proposed rates:
```
unit_rate_baseline = $0.90 / slot-hour
unit_rate_burst   = $1.35 / slot-hour (list)
requested_burst_rate = $1.01 / slot-hour (25% off list)
```
mike: rough calc looks like ~ $420k ARR if baseline fully utilized. 25% off burst looks aggressive for mixed GPU. what's the POC success criteria? who owns infra validation?
jordan: POC goals from SE side: p50 < 120ms, sustained qps 200, KV cache warm start <10ms. If we hit those, they convert to committed usage. SE will run canary traffic and validate autoscale. timeline: kickoff 2026-05-04, 6 weeks.
akash: engineering note — mixed A100/H100 autoscale and overprovisioning for burst is doable but adds complexity. We need at least 2 weeks before POC to validate fallback rules and quantization profiles. Also need to pin model variant to avoid runtime kernel churn.
lina: finance: we typically cap promotional burst discounts at 15% for first-year POC unless there's a clear ARR commitment. We can consider deeper discounts for >$500k ARR. Also need to know who signs off on true-up billing (monthly vs. quarterly).
carla: understood. I'll ask customer to firm up minimum commit threshold. Would team accept 15% conditional approval if commit >= $300k ARR and SOW includes canary fallback + monthly true-up?
legal: we need SOW language around outage fallbacks, data residency, and security questionnaire answers. Also add clause that burst pricing is temporary for POC and reverts to standard after conversion unless otherwise negotiated.
mike: deal desk decision: conditional approval for 15% burst discount if:
- Minimum commit >= $300k ARR
- SOW includes canary fallback and rollback playbook
- Monthly true-up billing
- Finance signs off on net present value (lina to confirm)
:thumbsup:
lina: finance confirms 15% ok with above conditions and a 6-week ramp schedule. we'll need estimated monthly cashflow schedule in the SOW.
carla: great — I'll update terms with 15% and draft SOW + security questionnaire responses. Will request infra prep window of 2 weeks before 2026-05-04 kickoff. @akash can you confirm availability for prep week starting 2026-04-20?
akash: blocking calendar now, can do prep window but need ticket to eng-runtime for mixed-GPU autoscale tests. please open in eng-runtime and tag me.
carla: will open ticket and share draft SOW in this thread. thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
mike: vote recorded; posting final conditions to deal-desk channel after SOW created.
carla: will follow up with customer and post updates here.
